fontLicensePolicy: Existing renamed Source Sans 3 Regular WOFF2 reused unchanged at weight400 in both variants. Original source and OFL notice retained.
mode: Previously generated photographic sources and paper presentation reused unchanged. Native vector typography and chart geometry composed separately. No new image generation.

layout_record.method: Declared fill-only changes distinguish complementary hue from value contrast. Hue angles use the digital HSL wheel. Hue replacements approximately match relative luminance; the final example intentionally changes only panel lightness at nominal fixed hue/saturation.

comparisonPolicy: Only one/two/one fills change. Badge pale blue becomes opposing muted orange at approximately equal relative luminance; Hill bars change from neighboring blue to opposing orange with approximately matched luminance; blue product-panel lightness42% becomes20% at nominal HSL210/60 while orange text stays fixed. All unrelated variables and image bytes/crops remain identical.
colorModel: Digital HSL hue opposition near210°/30°. This does not claim universal perceptual opposites, exact equal perceived lightness, physical pigment mixing or maximum perceptual contrast.

verification.textBounds: within the declared paper or phone surface
verification.pixelCheck: Only intended declared complementary-color intervention regions differ.
verification.scope: Exact DOM normalization permits only declared fills. All other nodes, font/photo source bytes, crop geometry, wording and values remain identical. Browser checks cover loaded fonts, fitting text, wide/stacked surfaces, horizontal overflow and SVG image/inline equality. Pixel differences occur only in declared color regions.

limitations: Original editorial judgments, not measured attention, comprehension or preference. Approximate luminance matching after 8-bit sRGB quantization does not establish equal perceived lightness. Specified-color ratios describe native solid fills, not physical print proof or complete accessibility conformance. Categories retain direct labels.
